messages:
clara: opened PR #5921 to migrate dashboard examples from metrics-v1 to metrics-v2. included Python + Node snippets and a compact JSON widget. preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5921
ben: taking Python snippet and link sweep.
omar: i'll check the Node snippet and the widget JSON keys.
rachel: i'll do a quick visual QA on the snapshot images.
clara: python snippet currently:
```python
from redwood import Redwood
client = Redwood(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
chart = client.console.get_dashboard('billing').panels.cost_breakdown()
print(chart)
```
ben: small API rename: `.panels.cost_breakdown()` is now `.panels.costBreakdown()` in the SDK. also missing `import os`. i'll push a tiny fix.
omar: node snippet uses older param `legend: 'pct'` which the widget no longer accepts; needs `legendMode: 'percent'`. replacing now.
rachel: snapshot shows legend overlapping on narrow widths; i'll note that in the PR. maybe reduce font-size in preset.
link-bot: linkcheck: broken link -> /docs/console/metrics-old -> 404. suggested -> /docs/console/metrics-v2
clara: updated the broken link to metrics-v2 and added a short migration note about renamed legend keys.
ben: pushed python fix: added import os and method rename to costBreakdown(). also added a one-line note on the snippet about handling empty responses.
omar: pushed node fix and replaced `legend` -> `legendMode`. adjusted widget JSON to use `cost_us` field.
rachel: reviewed snapshots after changes; visuals look better but mobile legend still clipped. filing follow-up ticket #922 for widget preset tweak.
docs-bot: preview build passed for branch docs/pr-5921  warnings: 1 (image alt length). build: https://ci.redwood.ai/11345
clara: thanks all. can someone approve so we can land before next docs cut?
ben: approved.
omar: approved.
clara: merging now. will watch staging and open follow-up for the mobile legend fix.
deploy-bot: docs deploy queued for staging  job 11367
clara: created follow-up issue #923 to add a short note on how legendMode selection affects cost attribution and a tiny example for SLO owners about batch size vs 95th latency.
ben: noted, will draft that mini-guide.
